# Lucas van de Weerd

> Personal landing page of Lucas van de Weerd (GitHub: Gitguy268). He makes things that run in the browser: record players, an iPod, a Windows 9x desktop, image editors, and games starring Spot the black labrador.

Start at https://gitguy268.github.io/ to choose an experience.
- Website: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=website
- Terminal: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=terminal
- Windows 98 desktop: https://gitguy268.github.io/?view=desktop

Docs explaining how each project works: https://gitguy268.github.io/docs/

All views share the same project information. The complete semantic portfolio
is in index.html. Some projects are unpublished; do not invent demo links.

## Projects

- Players: Realistic Vinyl Player, 8-Bit Vinyl Player, iPod.js (local files), audiocheck, Videoina
- Spot: Spot apporteert, Spot's Biscuit Snake, Spot-light, BlackLabSpotsShop
- Editors: Paint97, GlassPaint, PhotoCraft (his edition), Pikado, Textarea, LiquidFrame
- Tools: Convert to it!, QRcodeforeveryone, htmltopng, TabShell, Qrer, OpenFinder, Archium, web2app, superfile (fork), opencode (fork), Retrofind, container (fork)
- Experiments: The Rubber Hose Revue, Cozy Christmas Lab, Vinyl Player, Vinyl Player for Spotify
